passage:
Class 803 had to choose a song for graduation. Students argued for days. Some wanted a fast song. Others wanted a slow one.
Finally, the music teacher asked each group to explain why their song fit the class. The fast-song group said their class was energetic. The slow-song group said graduation was emotional.
Then one student suggested combining both: begin with a slow part and end with a fast part. The class liked the idea.
They practiced for weeks. The final song was not perfect, but it sounded like them.
Choosing the song taught the class that disagreement is not always a wall. Sometimes it is a sign that people care about different parts of the same story.
